import json, hashlib, pathlib, sys, datetime
P=pathlib.Path.cwd()
S=P/"sources/exfor"
EXPECTED_PACKET="d8b0b92f0374f73fa7f838db5ca07be45bd448696654b07c6db71c5847235ac2"
EXPECTED_MANIFEST="a1c5d4009d0bfacc4edcb248a6878eef6cdafa9690b4ea0d0826dd5356052d06"
PIN="939a14d7bba1ddce51975cb5e8711ce96b3b0871"
packet=json.loads((S/"PROVIDER_ROWS.json").read_text())
aux=json.loads((S/"AUXILIARY_ROWS.json").read_text())
excluded=json.loads((S/"EXCLUDED_ROWS.json").read_text())
manifest=json.loads((S/"MANIFEST.json").read_text())
contract=json.loads((P/"CONTRACT.json").read_text())
rows={r["subentry"]:r for r in packet["rows"]}
groups=[]
active=None
def require(ok, description):
    active["assertions"]+=1
    if not ok: raise AssertionError(description)
def group(gid,name,fn):
    global active
    active={"id":gid,"name":name,"result":"running","assertions":0}
    try:
        fn()
        active["result"]="pass_scoped"
    except Exception as e:
        active["result"]="fail"
        active["error_class"]=type(e).__name__
        active["error"]=str(e)
    groups.append(active)
def h(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def native(sub, source_file):
    lines=(S/source_file).read_text().split("\n")
    starts=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("SUBENT") and len(l.split())>1 and l.split()[1]==sub]
    if len(starts)!=1: raise ValueError("subentry not unique: "+sub)
    start=starts[0]
    end=next(i for i in range(start+1,len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("ENDSUBENT"))
    data=[i for i in range(start,end) if lines[i].split()[:1]==["DATA"]]
    if len(data)!=1: raise ValueError("DATA block not unique: "+sub)
    d=data[0]
    nc,nr=map(int,lines[d].split()[1:3])
    columns=[lines[d+1].ljust(nc*11)[11*j:11*(j+1)].strip() for j in range(nc)]
    units=[lines[d+2].ljust(nc*11)[11*j:11*(j+1)].strip() for j in range(nc)]
    body=[]
    for j in range(nr):
        line=lines[d+3+j]
        cells=[line.ljust(nc*11)[11*k:11*(k+1)] for k in range(nc)]
        body.append({"line":line,"line1":d+4+j,"cells":cells,"values":dict(zip(columns,[x.strip() for x in cells]))})
    if not lines[d+3+nr].startswith("ENDDATA"): raise ValueError("DATA row count mismatch "+sub)
    return {"lines":lines,"start1":start+1,"end1":end+1,"data1":d+1,"columns":columns,"units":units,"body":body,"enddata1":d+4+nr}
def compare_table(r):
    n=native(r["subentry"],r["source_file"]); v=r["raw_values"]
    require(v["row_count"]==len(n["body"])==len(v["rows"]),"native row count "+r["id"])
    require(v["columns"]==n["columns"] and v["column_units"]==n["units"],"headers/units "+r["id"])
    require(r["units"]==dict(zip(n["columns"],n["units"])),"unit map "+r["id"])
    require((v["DATA_line_1based"],v["header_line_1based"],v["units_line_1based"],v["ENDDATA_line_1based"])==(n["data1"],n["data1"]+1,n["data1"]+2,n["enddata1"]),"DATA locators "+r["id"])
    require(v["raw_header"]==n["lines"][n["data1"]] and v["raw_units"]==n["lines"][n["data1"]+1],"raw headers "+r["id"])
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(v["rows"],n["body"]),1):
        require(a["source_row_1based"]==i and a["source_line_1based"]==b["line1"],"native row locator "+r["id"]+":"+str(i))
        require(a["raw_line"]==b["line"],"raw line "+r["id"]+":"+str(i))
        require(a["fixed_width_cells"]==b["cells"],"fixed width cells "+r["id"]+":"+str(i))
        require(a["values"]==b["values"],"literal numeric cells "+r["id"]+":"+str(i))
    return n
def provenance():
    require(h(S/"PROVIDER_ROWS.json")==EXPECTED_PACKET,"frozen provider SHA")
    require(h(S/"MANIFEST.json")==EXPECTED_MANIFEST,"frozen manifest SHA")
    require(manifest["provider_commit"]==PIN==contract["new_dependency"]["commit"],"pinned source commit")
    require(manifest["provider_repository"]=="IAEA-NDS/exfor_master","official repository")
    for f in manifest["files"]:
        p=(S/f["file"]).resolve()
        require(S.resolve() in p.parents,"manifest path containment")
        require(p.stat().st_size==f["bytes"] and h(p)==f["sha256"],"manifest bytes/SHA "+f["file"])
    expected=json.loads((S/"provenance/RETRIEVAL_EXPECTED.json").read_text())
    for f in expected["files"]:
        b=(S/f["file"]).read_bytes()
        git=hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()
        require(git==f["git_blob_SHA1"],"Git blob identity "+f["file"])
        require("/"+PIN+"/" in f["source_url"],"immutable URL "+f["file"])
    for r in rows.values():
        p=S/r["source_file"]
        require(h(p)==r["source_SHA256"] and p.stat().st_size==r["source_bytes"],"row source identity "+r["id"])
        require(r["source_repository_commit"]==PIN and "/"+PIN+"/" in r["source_url"],"row pinned URL "+r["id"])
def native_tables():
    require(set(rows)=={"M0011002","M0475002","M0475003","M0826002"},"four selected subentries")
    expected_counts={"M0011002":14,"M0475002":12,"M0475003":6,"M0826002":4}
    expected_columns={"M0011002":["EN","DATA","ERR-S"],"M0475002":["EN","ANG-CM","DATA-CM","ERR-S"],"M0475003":["EN","DATA","ERR-S"],"M0826002":["EN-MIN","EN-MAX","DATA","ERR-S"]}
    for sub,r in rows.items():
        n=compare_table(r)
        require(len(n["body"])==expected_counts[sub] and n["columns"]==expected_columns[sub],"selected native schema "+sub)
        require("(TABLE)" in "".join(x["content"] for x in r["native_BIB_fields"]["STATUS"]),"TABLE status "+sub)
        quantity="DA" if sub=="M0475002" else "SIG"
        require(r["native_reaction"]=="(2-HE-4(G,D)1-H-2,,"+quantity+")","native reaction "+sub)
    require(packet["provider_variant_count"]==4 and packet["native_numeric_row_count"]==36,"packet counts")
    require(packet["integral_SIG_rows"]==24 and packet["angular_differential_DA_rows"]==12,"observable counts")
def locators():
    def visit(obj,lines):
        if isinstance(obj,dict):
            if "raw_line" in obj and "line_1based" in obj:
                require(lines[obj["line_1based"]-1]==obj["raw_line"],"single-line source locator")
                if "content" in obj: require(obj["raw_line"][11:]==obj["content"],"BIB content exact")
            if "raw_lines" in obj:
                a,b=obj["line_start_1based"],obj["line_end_1based"]
                require(lines[a-1:b]==obj["raw_lines"],"source block locator")
            for x in obj.values(): visit(x,lines)
        elif isinstance(obj,list):
            for x in obj: visit(x,lines)
    for r in list(rows.values())+aux["rows"]:
        lines=(S/r["source_file"]).read_text().split("\n")
        visit(r["locator"],lines)
        visit(r["native_BIB_fields"],lines)
        visit(r["native_parent_BIB_fields"],lines)
        visit(r["uncertainty"]["source_ERR_ANALYS"],lines)
        n=native(r["subentry"],r["source_file"])
        require((r["locator"]["subentry_line_start_1based"],r["locator"]["subentry_line_end_1based"])==(n["start1"],n["end1"]),"subentry endpoints "+r["id"])
        parent=r["accession"]+"001"
        require(r["locator"]["parent_subentry"]==parent,"parent inheritance "+r["id"])
        require(lines[r["locator"]["parent_line_start_1based"]-1].split()[1]==parent,"parent start "+r["id"])
        require(lines[r["locator"]["parent_line_end_1based"]-1].startswith("ENDSUBENT"),"parent end "+r["id"])
def observables():
    expected={"M0011002":("SIG","MICRO-B"),"M0475002":("DA","NB/SR"),"M0475003":("SIG","NB"),"M0826002":("SIG","MICRO-B")}
    for sub,r in rows.items():
        q,u=expected[sub]
        require(r["normalization"]["native_quantity"]==q,"SIG/DA unchanged "+sub)
        require(r["units"][r["normalization"]["native_data_heading"]]==u,"native area/area-sr units "+sub)
        sp=r["support"]
        require(sp["incident_energy_frame"]=="LAB_BY_EXFOR_HEADING_CONVENTION","incident EN lab convention "+sub)
        require(sp["energy_resolution"] is None and sp["incident_energy_response_or_bin_weights"] is None,"unreported energy response "+sub)
        require(sp["energy_integral_sigma_dE"] is False and sp["interpolation_or_extrapolation_performed"] is False,"no energy integral/interpolant "+sub)
        require(sp["native_energy_bin_edges_retained"] is (sub=="M0826002"),"native bin distinction "+sub)
    d=rows["M0475002"]
    require(d["support"]["angular_frame"]=="CM_EXPLICIT_ANG-CM_AND_DATA-CM","CM angle and cross section")
    data=d["raw_values"]["rows"]
    require({x["values"]["EN"] for x in data}=={"213.","258.","330."},"three actual lab energies")
    require({x["values"]["ANG-CM"] for x in data}=={"46.","61.","73.","87."},"four actual CM angles")
    b=rows["M0826002"]["raw_values"]["rows"]
    require([(x["values"]["EN-MIN"],x["values"]["EN-MAX"]) for x in b]==[("30.","40."),("40.","50."),("50.","60."),("60.","75.")],"four actual bin edges")
def uncertainties():
    for sub,r in rows.items():
        u=r["uncertainty"]
        require(u["statistical_column"]=="ERR-S" and u["native_unit"]==r["units"]["ERR-S"],"statistical column native unit "+sub)
        require(u["covariance"] is None and u["combined_uncertainty"] is None and u["confidence_probability"] is None,"no manufactured uncertainty "+sub)
        require(u["other_systematic_uncertainty"] is None and u["missing_uncertainty_is_zero"] is False,"unknown systematic retained "+sub)
        require(u["source_ERR_ANALYS"]==r["native_parent_BIB_fields"]["ERR-ANALYS"],"parent uncertainty inherited "+sub)
        bound=u["beam_intensity_systematic_bound"]
        if sub=="M0826002":
            require(bound is not None and bound["upper_bound_literal"]=="5." and bound["unit"]=="percent","beam upper bound literal")
            require(bound["relation"]=="not higher than" and bound["EXFOR_code"]=="(ERR-SYS,,5.)","upper bound semantics")
            require(bound["combined_with_statistical_error"] is False and bound["confidence_probability"] is None and bound["correlation_matrix"] is None,"no Gaussian/quadrature/covariance")
        else: require(bound is None,"no inherited systematic from other experiment "+sub)
def identities():
    for r in list(rows.values())+aux["rows"]:
        require(r["record_class"]=="PRIMARY_SOURCE_ROW","record source class "+r["id"])
        require(r["target_ids"]==[6] and r["target_directions"]=={"6":"target_forward"} and r["family_ids"]==["d_d_gamma"] and r["direction"]=="family_reverse","target direction binding "+r["id"])
        st=r["state_resolution"]
        require(st["source_target_nuclide"]=="2-HE-4" and st["source_emitted_particle"]=="D" and st["source_residual"]=="1-H-2" and st["source_isotopes_explicit"] is True,"source isotope labels "+r["id"])
        require(all(st[k] is None for k in ["electronic_state","ionic_charge","nuclear_isomer_or_excitation_binding"]) and st["source_native_state_bound_to_bare_projection"] is False,"no implicit state promotion "+r["id"])
        require(r["branch"]["products"]=={"D":2} and r["branch"]["branch_fraction"] is None,"identical products not a branch probability "+r["id"])
        require(r["Q"]["value"] is None and r["Q"]["uncertainty"] is None and r["Q"]["mass_convention"] is None and r["Q"]["admitted"] is False,"Q unresolved "+r["id"])
        require(all(r[k] is False for k in ["new_rate_admission","new_Q_admission","activation","default_active","exclusive_channel_binding","source_value_evaluated_in_this_intake","figure_digitization_performed"]),"physical gates unchanged "+r["id"])
def normalization():
    for r in list(rows.values())+aux["rows"]:
        n=r["normalization"]
        require(n["native_coefficient_to_event_flux_binding"] is False and n["new_angular_integration_performed"] is False and n["new_factor_of_two_or_factorial_applied"] is False,"no constructed rate or counting correction "+r["id"])
        require("UNRESOLVED" in n["identical_dd_particle_vs_event_counting"] and "UNRESOLVED" in n["full_sphere_or_half_sphere_normalization"],"normalization obligations retained "+r["id"])
        require(r["support"]["source_to_consumer_binding"] is False and r["branch"]["auxiliary_added_to_total"] is False,"no consumer or E2 summation "+r["id"])
    require(rows["M0475002"]["accession"]==rows["M0475003"]["accession"]=="M0475","shared experiment identity")
    require(rows["M0475002"]["primary_publication_references"]==rows["M0475003"]["primary_publication_references"],"shared publication preserved")
    report=(S/"SOURCE_RECOVERY_KO.md").read_text()
    require("통계적으로 독립적인 네 실험이라는 뜻이 아니다" in report,"four tables not statistical independence")
def auxiliary_and_exclusions():
    require(aux["counted_as_primary_provider"] is False and aux["counted_in_36_rows"] is False,"aux count separation")
    require(len(aux["rows"])==1 and aux["rows"][0]["subentry"]=="M0011003","one E2 auxiliary")
    a=aux["rows"][0]; n=compare_table(a)
    require(len(n["body"])==7 and a["native_reaction"]=="(2-HE-4(G,D)1-H-2,EP,SIG)" and a["branch"]["source_component"]=="E2","native E2 component")
    block=a["locator"]["COMMON"]["raw_lines"]
    require(block[1].strip()=="POLAR" and block[2].strip()=="NO-DIM" and block[3].strip()=="2.","native E2 COMMON")
    require({x["subentry"] for x in excluded["rows"]}=={"M0826003","M0034005","M0034006"},"explicit CURVE exclusions")
    for x in excluded["rows"]:
        lines=(S/x["source_file"]).read_text().split("\n")
        require(h(S/x["source_file"])==x["source_SHA256"],"excluded raw identity")
        require(lines[x["line_start_1based"]-1].split()[1]==x["subentry"] and lines[x["line_end_1based"]-1].startswith("ENDSUBENT"),"excluded source span")
        require(any("(CURVE" in a["content"] for a in x["STATUS"]),"source CURVE status")
        for a in x["STATUS"]: require(lines[a["line_1based"]-1]==a["raw_line"],"CURVE exact locator")
def publication_and_scope():
    sem=json.loads((S/"SEMANTICS_REFERENCE.json").read_text())
    require(sem["source_url"]=="https://nds.iaea.org/nrdc/nrdc_doc/iaea-nds-0208-202505.pdf","official LEXFOR reference")
    require(sem["source_SHA256"] is None and sem["raw_pdf_bytes_bundled"] is False,"honest manual retrieval scope")
    require({x["section"] for x in sem["definitions"]}=={"C.1","C.8","D.13","M.12"},"reviewed definition scope")
    require("Attribution 4.0 International" in (S/"provenance/LICENSE.txt").read_text() and manifest["data_license"]=="CC-BY-4.0","distribution license retained")
    for r in rows.values():
        require(r["full_primary_paper_retrieved_for_this_packet"] is False,"no full-paper retrieval claim "+r["id"])
        require(r["primary_publication_references"]==r["native_parent_BIB_fields"]["REFERENCE"],"original author references retained "+r["id"])
    require(all(v is False for v in contract["physical_admission"].values()),"contract physical scope")
    require(contract["execution_budget"]["inherited_PHYS91_primary_remaining"]==0 and contract["execution_budget"]["inherited_PHYS91_reference_remaining"]==0 and contract["execution_budget"]["inherited_PHYS91_Wolfram_remaining"]==0,"old budgets retained")
    require(contract["execution_budget"]["historical_global_CPU_s"] is None and contract["execution_budget"]["global_remaining"] is None,"unknown global cost retained")
for args in [
 ("G1","Frozen packet and exact provider bytes",provenance),
 ("G2","Four selected TABLEs and all native numeric cells",native_tables),
 ("G3","Row/BIB/COMMON locators and parent inheritance",locators),
 ("G4","Observable, frame, unit and bin distinctions",observables),
 ("G5","Statistical errors and bounded beam systematic",uncertainties),
 ("G6","Isotope/direction/state/Q/admission separation",identities),
 ("G7","Identical-product and shared-experiment normalization",normalization),
 ("G8","E2 auxiliary and CURVE exclusion boundaries",auxiliary_and_exclusions),
 ("G9","Publication provenance and bounded claim scope",publication_and_scope)]:
    group(*args)
passed=all(g["result"]=="pass_scoped" for g in groups)
result={
 "schema":"WU_TARGET6_EXFOR_INDEPENDENT_INTAKE_REVIEW_V1",
 "reviewer":"/root/provider_rows","source_author":"/root/molecule_sources",
 "created_UTC":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "decision":"PASS_SCOPED_SOURCE_INTAKE" if passed else "FAIL",
 "execution_scope":"Single bounded independent read of the changed EXFOR packet; no source-author parser imported; no old suite or compiler called.",
 "source_commit":PIN,"packet_SHA256":h(S/"PROVIDER_ROWS.json"),"expected_packet_SHA256":EXPECTED_PACKET,
 "manifest_SHA256":h(S/"MANIFEST.json"),"expected_manifest_SHA256":EXPECTED_MANIFEST,
 "contract_SHA256":h(P/"CONTRACT.json"),
 "groups":groups,"passed_groups":sum(g["result"]=="pass_scoped" for g in groups),"group_count":len(groups),
 "assertions":sum(g["assertions"] for g in groups),
 "audited_source_counts":{"main_TABLE_subentries":4,"main_native_rows":36,"main_native_numeric_cells":124,"integral_SIG_rows":24,"angular_differential_DA_rows":12,"auxiliary_E2_rows_separate":7,"auxiliary_native_numeric_cells_separate":21,"excluded_target6_CURVE_subentries":3},
 "count_qualification":"TABLE records are not independent-experiment counts; native-cell comparisons are implementation evidence, not physical approvals.",
 "semantic_review":{"method":"Independent reading of all four raw entries, frozen metadata, and official LEXFOR sections; conditional number/normalization derivation in INTAKE_REVIEW.md.",
  "official_manual_URL":sem["source_url"] if False else "https://nds.iaea.org/nrdc/nrdc_doc/iaea-nds-0208-202505.pdf",
  "sections":["C.1","C.8","D.13","M.12"],"manual_full_bytes_or_SHA_verified":False,
  "pre_freeze_clarifications":["EP/POLAR=2 is E2, kept separate from total SIG","energy-bin SIG has area units, not an incident-energy integral","M0475002/003 share an experiment and do not imply independent covariance","identical-dd event stoichiometry is separate from angular particle counting"]},
 "open_consumer_obligations":["Native reaction identity is not an atomic-charge or state binding","Incident-energy response/bin weights and angular acceptance/integration are not supplied in selected entries","Differential particle/event and full-sphere/half-sphere normalization requires explicit source/consumer convention","No data-driven interpolation/extrapolation or actual photon-spectrum consumer is admitted","No covariance, combined confidence interval, new Q or deposition partition is supplied"],
 "execution_receipt":"../raw/independent01/RECEIPT.json",
 "executable_source_identity":"Exact python -c program is preserved in raw/independent01/REQUEST.json and RECEIPT.json command argv",
 "overlay_code_review":"Separate authority_survey static review; this result does not claim execution of overlay checker",
 "new_rate_evaluations":0,"new_Q_evaluations":0,"new_angular_integrations":0,"old_science_replays":0,"old_compiler_calls":0,
 "physical_rate_Q_consumer_admission":False}
(P/"reviews").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(P/"reviews/INTAKE_REVIEW.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"decision":result["decision"],"groups":result["passed_groups"],"group_count":len(groups),"assertions":result["assertions"],"failures":[g for g in groups if g["result"]=="fail"],"output":"reviews/INTAKE_REVIEW.json"},ensure_ascii=False))
sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)
